records.title: Service Enlistment Medical Fitness Examination
records.diagnosis: Initial military medical fitness examination completed. Classified SHAPE-1. Immunizations current. Enrolled in Kavach Health Tracker.

records.title: Battle Shrapnel Injury - Right Shoulder
records.diagnosis: Splinter wound right deltoid sustained during desert tactical firing exercise. Clean surgical debridement performed. No neurovascular deficit.

records.title: Left Knee Arthroscopic Meniscus Repair
records.diagnosis: Grade III Medial Meniscus Tear sustained during high-altitude patrol on snow-covered scree. Partial meniscectomy and stabilization performed under spinal anesthesia.

records.title: Digital Radiograph - Left Knee & Lumbar Spine
records.diagnosis: Joint effusion present at left tibiofemoral joint space with early patellar tracking deviation. No acute bony fracture seen.

records.title: High Altitude Prophylaxis & Vaccination Pack
records.posting: Siachen Base Camp (Extreme Cold / High Altitude)
records.diagnosis: Tetanus Toxoid Booster, Quadrivalent Meningococcal & Acetazolamide adaptation pack completed prior to Kumar Post transit.

records.title: Post-Op Analgesic & Joint Chondroitin Regimen
records.diagnosis: Tab Aceclofenac 100mg BD x 7d, Tab Glucosamine-Chondroitin OD x 60d, Ice cryotherapy 3x daily, non-weight bearing crutches.

records.title: Confidential Combat Stress & Sleep Disturbance Assessment
records.diagnosis: Patient reports recurrent nightmares and hypervigilance following high-altitude patrol incident. Screening shows rising PHQ-9 (moderate score 13). Initiated trauma-informed cognitive behavioral therapy.

access_grants.purpose: Disability & Combat Injury Verification for ECHS Claim

screenings.clinical_advice: Scores indicate elevated post-traumatic stress. Confidential trauma counseling is available without command notification.
Mild situational tension. Relaxation and peer support recommended.
